title: Reminder and Calendar Notifications Not Appearing on Lock Screen After iOS Update
body:
i am experiencing an issue after the recent updating my iphone 17 Pro Max to the latest iOS version.

before the update, Reminder and Calendar alerts appeared normally on my lock screen. after the update, scheduled reminders and calendar notifications no longer appear on the lock screen at all.

Details: 
-Notifications for reminders and calendar and Mail are enabled.
-Lock screen notifications are enabled. 
- Whatsapp and messages notifications working fine.
- Reminder and calendar alerts do not appear on Lock screen.
- Yahoo calendar reminder emails are received but no notifications is displayed on the iphone.
- This issue started immediately after the iOS update
- All previous completed  reminders records were deleted 

Please investigate whether this is a bug issue for the latest iOS 26.5 update. 

The app used to be very helpful for reminding users about tasks that needed to be completed at scheduled times. However, it has now lost much of its effectiveness.
